meta.objective: Execute the GPT-4.1-only targeted rerun cohort for V4: rerun Gilardi baseline and l2 plus Zheng baseline and abstention, then compare the reruns against the first-pass outputs.

decisions.statement: Constrain the rerun budget to GPT-4.1 only. Repeat the four GPT-4.1 cells that either anchored the main claims or showed first-pass movement.
Treat the Zheng GPT-4.1 abstention effect as unstable unless it repeats. The rerun is the deciding check for whether that one-item movement is signal or noise.

If Gilardi baseline and Zheng abstention repeat exactly while Zheng baseline or Gilardi l2 move by only one borderline item, promote the first-pass claims but describe those cells as near-boundary rather than fully deterministic.
